name: NAIP
source: Natsume, a 17-year term expires living alone in an apartment by the strange business of his father, a regular student lives with their classmates without further until one day call it a job recommendation, then the subconscious memories altered forgetting the following hours, the next morning he learns he is not alone in that department ...
translation: 夏目，17年的学期结束了，由于父亲的奇怪的事情，独自住在公寓里，一名普通学生与同学一起生活，直到有一天称之为工作推荐，然后潜意识记忆发生了变化，忘记了接下来的时间，第二天早上，他得知自己在那个部门并不孤单……
